ns2:course.label: Wave Physics in Wireless: from Fundamentals to Frontiers
ns2:course.description: Wave physics of wireless communication from basic information transmission to emerging technologies in fifth-generation (5G) systems and beyond. The goal is to bridge the students’ knowledge gap between electromagnetic theory, information theory, and signal processing. Students will learn physics-based modeling of the wireless system through electromagnetic theory to master the formulation and development of commensurate communication theory. Prerequisite: ECE 350 or ECE 520.
